items.title: From polycrisis to polysolutions
items.text: Today's development challenges are increasingly interconnected, demanding more than isolated responses. IP3 helps governments, development partners and institutions navigate these complexities through evidence-based policy advice, strategic analysis and practical solutions tailored to each challenge—addressing underlying risks, institutional realities and long-term development priorities.

items.title: Translation, not theory
items.text: IP3 bridges the gap between evidence and implementation. We develop practical policy roadmaps, feasibility studies, investment cases, implementation plans, and monitoring frameworks tailored to each assignment. By considering institutional capacity, financing needs, and real-world delivery constraints, we help clients make informed decisions and turn development strategies into actionable programmes.

items.title: Thinking that ships
items.text: IP3 connects rigorous research, data-driven insights, and applied analysis with real-world development challenges, generating actionable evidence, decision-ready diagnostics, business cases and evaluations to inform policies, investments, and institutional reforms — not publications for their own sake.

items.title: A convenor between worlds
items.text: Structured policy dialogue, investment forums and technical working groups that align governments, capital and implementers.
